_doc: Everything Yunshu took from another project. kind: vendored = copied file; derived = rewritten from specific upstream files; inspired = same algorithm, independent code; patches = we monkeypatch an upstream symbol (source_sha256 pins the code we depend on). scripts/vendor/check_upstream.py reports upstream changes since 'commit'. 'local_changes' lists deliberate edits to keep on a sync. watch = every reference clone we follow for ideas or fixes (commit = reviewed up to). watch_excluded = every other clone with the reason it is not followed; scripts/vendor/check_upstream.py fails when a clone is in neither list. packages = extra pins on top of everything declared in pyproject.toml, which is read automatically. reviewed_commit/reviewed_date/review_reason record a deliberate retention after upstream review without rewriting the copied commit provenance. prior_art = discovery-only candidates with separate licenses/revisions/owners and pending actions; these are NOT adopted code, qualified loaders or parity passes.
